label: Рассказать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for рассказать (to tell, to narrate, perfective).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Расскажу' uses the mutated стем расскаж-; perfective рассказать has future meaning in its simple form. The imperfective partner is рассказывать.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person. 'Расскажешь' keeps the расскаж- stem with the -ешь ending. 'О поездке' is prepositional after о, marking the topic.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person. 'Расскажет' is the он-form ending in -ет. 'Всю правду' is the accusative object of the completed telling.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Расскажем' shows the мы-ending -ем on the расскаж- stem. 'Вам' is dative, 'план' accusative.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Расскажут' closes the future paradigm with the -ут ending. 'О своих планах' is prepositional after о.
Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Рассказал' is the masculine singular past of perfective рассказать. The aspect marks one finished story; 'анекдот' is accusative.
Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Рассказала' adds the feminine -а ending. 'Детям' is dative, 'сказку' the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Рассказали' is the plural past ending in -и. 'О происшествии' is prepositional after о, the topic of the account.
Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Расскажи' is the informal command of perfective рассказать. The perfective requests one complete account.
Strategic focus: Infinitive after a modal. 'Хочу' governs the bare infinitive 'рассказать'. The perfective infinitive points to one whole telling; 'секрет' is accusative.
